fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 47 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (190), strong dollar pressures multinationals, NFP event in 1 day adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 47 days present binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Oversold oscillators (Stoch, Williams %R, StochRSI) combined with fear-zone market sentiment and proximity to support (80.1992) create a contrarian mean-reversion opportunity if macro headwinds stabilize.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure—price below all key moving averages, negative volume flow (CMF, OBV), weak trend (ADX), no bullish confirmation, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and earnings binary risk in 47 days—overwhelm oversold technicals and eliminate confluence.
